description: What changed in Last Price: the newest release notes, optionally for one feature, written for agents as well as people. Pass feature (a tag such as billing, webhooks, mcp, agent-payments, approvals) to follow one part of the product, and since (YYYY-MM-DD, for example the date you last checked) to see only newer notes. Each note has its date, title, summary, category, feature tags, a link to the full note and, when there is one, the docs section and app screen it is about. Public: needs no credential. Check it at the start of a session and before changing integration code.

audience.description: Only notes written for this audience. Omit for both.

feature.description: A feature tag slug, for example billing. Omit for every feature.

limit.description: How many notes at most, newest first.

since.description: Only notes dated after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_changelog
